review_response_tasks.rationale: interpreted...as表示把安静解读为没兴趣，符合叙述者最初误判。supported支持、replaced替换、measured测量均不构成该对quietness的主观解释。
kept him out of planning且only/carry spare chairs表叙述者给次要角色，minor最佳。leading与排除策划矛盾；permanent长久性无证据；paid薪酬未提。
room中桌门椅位置和行进路线的纸是map。menu列餐食、receipt收据、diary日记均不承载此空间布局。
exact place of every turn及所需空间体现详尽detailed。angry无情绪证据；hurried匆促与carefully marked解释不符；uncertain与exact信息相反。
meeting中几乎不说话、先思考写纸说明难加入快速交谈。journeys旅程、repairs修理、competitions竞赛不是本文交流方式。
发现误判后apologised，对自己早先决定羞愧embarrassed。proud自豪、relieved如释重负、unconcerned不在意均与道歉及反省不符。
asked everyone for ideas是征求想法，与改为书面参与一致。blamed指责、charged收费、frightened吓唬均不表示征询意见。
之后按图摆桌说明采用adopted。cancelled取消、misplaced弄丢、concealed隐藏均与实际执行其位置方案冲突。
由先快谈排人改为征集书面意见，是合作方式changed。failed失败、disappeared消失、stopped停止都与继续成功合作不符。
完整故事反省给人展示贡献的机会opportunity。order命令、excuse借口、warning警告均不概括从预判分工转向参与的学习。

completed_passage:
At our first meeting for a school display, Finn said almost nothing. I interpreted his quietness as a lack of interest. When we shared the work, I kept him out of the planning group and gave him only a minor role: carrying spare chairs.

The following afternoon, Finn arrived holding a folded sheet of paper. It was a map of the room, with the tables, doors and chairs carefully marked. He had noticed that our planned line of visitors would block the entrance. His explanation was detailed: he showed the exact place of every turn and the space each table needed.

Later, Finn told me that he found it difficult to join fast conversations. He preferred to think first and then put his ideas on paper. I felt embarrassed about the decision I had made without asking him anything. I apologised and invited him to help arrange the whole display.

Before the next meeting, I asked everyone for ideas in writing. Finn's plan was adopted, and we put the tables in the positions he had drawn. The room itself was almost the same, but the way we worked had changed. I had learnt that people needed an opportunity to show what they could contribute, rather than a role chosen for them after one quick impression.
